notes.title: Update 1.11
notes.content:
[h1][b]Here is a short list of bugfixes and new Stuff added[/b][/h1]

[h2][b][u]Hotfixes:[/u][/b][/h2]
The player can no longer glitch outside the map-borders
Fixed a bug where the xp-orbs spawn with 100% certainty instead of 40%
Fixed a bug where the UI didnt pop up with ESC
Fixed a bug where the game wouldnt close after the player died

[h2][b][u]New Stuff:[/u][/b][/h2]
Added a Main menu with Options
Added Sounds (UI, FSX, Music etc.) but were adding more soon
Added a new Achivement
Added Steam Initialization for checking pirated game-versions
Added a Menu that displays current stats
Removed unneccessairy libraries and API's that dont get used

[h1]Try these new features and play the new Update now![/h1]

notes.title: Update 1.10
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the release of Update 1.10 for King's Recycle! This update includes a number of bug fixes, quality of life improvements, and new features to enhance your gameplay experience.

But we wont spoil whats coming, see for yourself ;)

As always, if you encounter any issues or have any feedback to share, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
We appreciate your help in making the game the best it can be.
